'''Takahiro Yamashita''' (Japanese: '''やましたたかひろ''' or '''山下たかひろ''' ''Yamashita Takahiro'', born November 22, 1969 in Kyoto) is the creator of several [[Pokémon manga]] and the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]], having illustrated {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Illus. by Takahiro Yamashita}} cards. Yamashita has worked on authoring and illustrating many video games into manga adaptations which were published in the [[CoroCoro]] magazines, these franchises including ''{{wp|Fatal Fury}}'', ''{{wp|Saturn Bomberman}}'', ''{{wp|Star Fox 64}}'' and ''{{wp|Fatal Fury}}''. Additionally, Yamashita has published manga for the magazine ''{{wp|Shogakukan|Shogaku Sannensei}}'' where his ''{{wp|Virtua Fighter}}'' manga adaptation appeared in. ==Pokémon manga by Takahiro Yamashita== * [[Pokémon 4Koma School]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia Gold and Silver]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia (Generation III)]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia Diamond and Pearl]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia Gag Stars]] * [[Pokémon 4Koma Plaza]] * [[Machamp's 24-Hour Strength Police!!]] * [[Is It Really Scary?
